node.title: M31 top-pair source-head saturation router
node.statement: Every maximal-overlap pair in the M31 proper-G zero-excess terminal saturates the reduced source determinant: A_i b_j-A_j b_i=(gamma_j-gamma_i)gcd(H_i,H_j), so top edges join distinct source-head values. Every head fiber has at most 458812 members. A violating family therefore uses at least five head values, has at least 1699117 full-head members, and its dense anchor forces at least 71643276 colored core cells.
node.notes: Exact source-sensitive top-edge coloring and spread reduction only. It does not aggregate head fibers, supply first-owner add-back, pay Q=147595, or move a Prize endpoint.
